description: Every authored enemy action binding. Generated metadata is not a runtime or fidelity receipt.

coverage.bindings: Each case requires its own enemy and row identity proof, outcome and cleanup receipt.
coverage.selection: Controlled row selection does not establish natural admission; requirements, priority and followup remain separate tests.
coverage.groups: Shared spell groups cover core recipes only. Physical and noncommon groups retain enemy identity and full authored context.
coverage.metadata: Requirements and unsupported reasons describe the pinned cooked files, not current runtime acceptance.
coverage.arena: Prefer available authored caller arenas, then smallest actual-actor formation and fewer duplicate targets. Use an explicit component arena only when none is available; retain all candidates.
